lessons.title: Shares and markups
lessons.scope: Standalone fixed-firm, constant-returns pricing illustration; not the full AB08 model or the main economy.

lessons.title: Entry incentives
lessons.scope: Standalone complete-information entry illustration with a common crowding penalty; separate from the main sequential-exit procedure.

lessons.title: Direct and simulated moments
lessons.scope: Independent fixed-seed moment-matching exercise using an exact within-sector variance reduction; no original inputs or full-economy solver required.

lessons.title: Entry and exit
lessons.scope: Main solver's active sets, profit checks, sequential deletions and pre-deletion stopping state; does not test profitable re-entry.

lessons.title: Cournot and equilibrium
lessons.scope: Main pricing fixed point conditional on operating firms, followed by aggregate output, wages and profits inside each exit round.

lessons.title: Parameters to moments
lessons.scope: Main parameter-to-draw-to-equilibrium-to-moment calculation. The lesson script solves any of the page's 17 saved economies again and compares every displayed number with the value saved for the page.

lessons.title: From parameter candidates to a selected economy
lessons.scope: Main Sobol design, input contract, candidate solves, weighted loss and selection. The annual targets and search boxes are in data/.

lessons.title: Untargeted moment
lessons.scope: Solves each year again at its unit 03 estimate with the estimation's draws, links firms by slot across adjacent years, and splits the change in the sales-weighted markup into within-firm change, reallocation and net entry. No re-estimation.

lessons.title: Parallel workers
lessons.scope: The full search runs one solver process per shard (lessons/03_estimation/full_search.py); lessons/04_parallel/scaling.py solves the page's 256 timed economies in a pool of worker processes.

lessons.title: Vectorization
lessons.scope: Main M-by-J share iteration normalizes within each market and freezes converged columns; the film illustrates one operation within that iteration. The lesson script times one call per market against one call for all markets.

lessons.title: GPU batches
lessons.scope: Current strict FP64 batch runner groups compatible firm counts within a cell budget and restores requested candidate order.

lessons.title: Kernel fusion (optional)
lessons.scope: Optional backend fuses one share update including firm reductions; the film's scale-and-add example is illustrative, not the full kernel.

lessons.title: Resident loops (optional)
lessons.scope: Optional resident FP64 correction preserves per-market stops and an independent final residual; default production selection is unchanged.

lessons.title: Profiling
lessons.scope: Maps the solver stages to instrument. The page's profiling snippet is pseudocode; no profiler command or original trace-collection harness is bundled.

lessons.title: Mixed precision (optional)
lessons.scope: Explicit experimental FP32 share prediction with mandatory FP64 correction and final checks; prices, roots, exit and moments stay FP64.

lessons.title: Fair comparison
lessons.scope: Maps ordered results, synchronization and numerical acceptance checks. The full CPU64/multi-GPU benchmark harness and raw timing logs are not bundled; per-batch timings do not reproduce the website's end-to-end clock.

lessons.title: Output equation (extra exercise)
lessons.scope: Records every output equation of unit 02's baseline economy and solves it with Newton's method, with the derivative by hand and by automatic differentiation, and with bisection; each root is compared with qmp's Brent root.
